# discord_current_application (Data Source)

Reads the Discord application associated with the configured bot token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_current_application" "this" {}

output "application_id" {
  value = data.discord_current_application.this.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `approximate_guild_count` (Number) Approximate number of guilds the app is in.
- `bot_public` (Boolean) Whether anyone can add the bot.
- `bot_require_code_grant` (Boolean) Whether the bot requires the OAuth2 code grant to be added.
- `custom_install_url` (String) Custom install URL.
- `description` (String) Application description.
- `flags` (Number) Application flags bitfield.
- `icon` (String) Application icon hash.
- `id` (String) Application snowflake ID.
- `interactions_endpoint_url` (String) Interactions endpoint URL.
- `name` (String) Application name.
- `privacy_policy_url` (String) Privacy policy URL.
- `role_connections_verification_url` (String) Role connections verification URL.
- `tags` (List of String) Up to 5 descriptive tags.
- `terms_of_service_url` (String) Terms of service URL.
